name: My Website is Slow, is it Hurting My AI Visibility?

step.name: Step 1: Technical Audit & Crawlability Check: This usually kicks off with a deep dive into your site's technical setup. Experts will check things like your robots.txt file, ensure hosting and CDN access are configured correctly, and verify that important content isn't being blocked from crawlers. They'll also check how well your pages are indexing and if they're eligible for rich snippets.

Experts will check things like your robots.txt file, ensure hosting and CDN access are configured correctly, and verify that important content isn't being blocked from crawlers. They'll also check how well your pages are indexing and if they're eligible for rich snippets.

step.name: Step 2: Content Rendering & Structured Data Validation: Next, they’ll look at how your content is rendered. Is crucial information appearing as plain text that AI can easily read? They’ll validate your structured data (like JSON-LD schema) to make sure it aligns perfectly with the visible content on your pages. This step is key for AI to understand and accurately cite your business.

step.name: Step 3: Performance & Mobile Experience Assessment: This involves testing your site's speed and responsiveness, especially on mobile devices. They'll review your Core Web Vitals using real-user data from Search Console, not just lab tests. This helps pinpoint actual performance bottlenecks affecting users and crawlers.

step.name: Step 4: Internal Linking & Site Structure Review: Your internal links help AI crawlers navigate and understand the hierarchy of your site. This step focuses on optimizing those links to ensure important pages are easily discoverable and related content is well-connected. They'll ensure there’s a logical flow for both users and machines.

step.name: Step 5: Ongoing Monitoring & Adjustment: Optimization isn't a one-time fix. Performance is continuously monitored in Search Console, looking at impressions, clicks, and user engagement. Based on this data, adjustments are made to keep your site performing optimally, ensuring continued AI visibility. This is an iterative process that reacts to how AI systems are interacting with your content.
